title: Valkey clients and integrations catalog
description: Rules for the files in `_data/libraries/`. `build/validate-libraries.py` checks each entry file listed under `clients` in `manifest.json` against `$defs/client` and each listed under `integrations` against `$defs/integration`. It checks `manifest.json` against `$defs/manifest` and `metadata.json` against `$defs/metadata`. It then runs the checks that span files or need the SPDX license list.
$comment: The script prints a rule's description when that rule fails, so each description is on the subschema that fails. Each `not` rule repeats `"type": "string"` so that a value of the wrong type is reported once, by `type`. The URL patterns' character classes allow whitespace, and in Python `$` also matches before a final newline, so a `not` rule rejects whitespace in URLs. The fields that clients and integrations share are each defined once in `$defs` and referenced with `$ref`.

client.description: A client entry, stored in `clients/`, is a JSON object that describes one client library.

features.description: An object of client feature flags with exactly the keys `replica`, `backoff`, `pubsub`, `scan`, `latency`, `az`, `csc`, `capa` and `pool`, each set to `true` or `false`.

replica.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

backoff.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

pubsub.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

scan.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

latency.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

az.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

csc.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

capa.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

pool.description: Set to `true` if the client supports this feature, otherwise `false`.

integration.description: An integration entry, stored in `integrations/`, is a JSON object that describes one tool, framework or AI library.

tags.$comment: The tag set is fixed on purpose: adding a tag is a deliberate change to this schema.
tags.description: A non-empty list of distinct tags.

items.description: Integration tags must be one of `CLI & GUI`, `Deploy & operate`, `Frameworks & ORMs`, `Queues & background jobs`, `RAG & retrieval`, `Agent memory`, `Agent frameworks` or `Inference & serving`.

name.description: The project's official name. It must not be blank or have spaces at either end.

description.description: One or two factual, vendor-neutral sentences of at most 200 characters. The text must not have spaces at either end.

license.description: An SPDX license expression made of OSI-approved licenses, such as `MIT` or `MIT OR Apache-2.0`. It must not be blank or have spaces at either end.

repository.$comment: The Valkey chip is derived from this URL, so dot segments are rejected: `https://github.com/valkey-io/x/tree/a/../../../rq/rq` would otherwise give a third-party repository the chip.
repository.description: The public source repository, as an `https://` URL with a lowercase host and no port or user name. Its path must not contain spaces, `?`, `#`, `\`, `%` or a `.` or `..` segment.

then.description: A GitHub repository URL is `https://github.com/OWNER/REPO`, or `https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/tree/REF/PATH` for a project in a subdirectory. It has no trailing slash and no `.git` suffix.

documentation.description: A page that shows how to use the project with Valkey. For a page on valkey.io, use a root-relative path that ends in `/`, such as `/topics/cli/` or `/topics/cli/#section`. Its segments use letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, and none starts with `.`. For any other site, use an `https://` URL with a lowercase host and no port or user name. The link must not contain spaces or `\`.

allOf.description: Link a page on `valkey.io` or `www.valkey.io` with a root-relative path such as `/topics/cli/` instead of a full URL.

then.description: GitHub links must start with `https://github.com/` and point at a tag such as `v1.2.3` or a commit hash. Link a file as `/OWNER/REPO/blob/REF/PATH` and a directory as `/OWNER/REPO/tree/REF` or `/OWNER/REPO/tree/REF/PATH`. `REF` must be a tag that contains a digit or a 40-character lowercase commit hash, so branch names such as `main` are rejected. Link a wiki page as `/OWNER/REPO/wiki/PAGE/REVISION`, where `REVISION` is the 40-character hash of a page revision. Repository roots and `#readme` links are rejected.

language.$comment: The language set is fixed on purpose: adding a language is a deliberate change to this schema.
language.description: The primary programming language, required for client entries and optional for integrations. It must be one of `C`, `C#`, `Go`, `Java`, `Node.js`, `PHP`, `Python`, `Ruby`, `Shell`, `Swift` or `TypeScript`.

installCommand.description: The primary install command, such as `pip install valkey-glide`, on one line with no spaces at either end.

manifest.description: A JSON object that lists the entry files to show in two groups, `clients` and `integrations`, by path relative to `_data/libraries/`.

clients.description: The paths of client entry files, such as `clients/valkey-py.json`.

integrations.description: The paths of tool and AI library entry files, such as `integrations/rq.json`.

metadata.description: A JSON object holding site text for the catalog pages.

featureDescriptions.description: A list of the client features in the order that cards and the legend show them.

items.description: An object with a feature's `key`, `label` and `definition`.

key.description: The feature's key in an entry's `features`.

label.description: The feature name that cards and the legend show. It must not be blank or have spaces at either end.

definition.description: The explanation that the legend shows. It must not be blank or have spaces at either end.
